text: Clubs and Organizations | Brooklyn College Clubs and Organizations Brooklyn College offers more than 150 student clubs and organizations spanning a broad range of artistic, community, cultural, ethnic, media, religious, social action, and other special interests. To find out more or to join an organization, visit Bulldog Connection. Log in to Bulldog Connection Selected Clubs The community of student organizations at Brooklyn College offers opportunities to gain personal development skills, leadership development, and tools necessary for academic success in order to achieve the goal of graduation. Choose from a variety of organizations that include: Academic and Professional Cultural and Identity-based Governance Graduate Students Greek Lettered Health and Wellness Performing Arts Political and Social Awareness Publications and Media Special Interest Spiritual and Faith-based Sports and Recreation Volunteer and Service Student Club Event Planning For more information about student organization event-planning processes and policies, consult the Student Club/Organization Handbook (PDF) .
